svg.title: Sammy the Opossum: Zombie Hunter
svg.desc: Pixel-art title banner: at night on a rain-slick Central Park terrace, Sammy the opossum, snarling in a red bandana, rips a rusty orange chainsaw clean through a zombie jogger in a spray of sparks and blood, while the horde shambles down the stairs past the bronze angel fountain under a big full moon and the city skyline.
